ConnectionStrings._comment: Local development only — not a secret, not used against any real environment. Real environments supply this via Key Vault / managed identity (CLAUDE.md Section 4.7), never a committed appsettings value.

Blob._comment: Real Azurite/Azure Storage connection strings contain a base64 account key gitleaks' azure-storage-account-key rule matches on shape alone, same reasoning as the Stripe section below — ConnectionStrings:Blob above is deliberately not key-shaped for that reason.

PlayServices._comment: Local development only — not a real secret. HMAC key for M7 Phase 7's anonymous play-identity tokens (Forge.Infrastructure.Play.PlayTokenService). Real environments supply this via Key Vault / managed identity (CLAUDE.md Section 4.7).

Stripe._comment: Local development only — not real keys, not a secret. Deliberately not shaped like sk_/whsec_ (a real Stripe key/secret prefix) even as an obvious placeholder — gitleaks' stripe-access-token rule matches on shape alone, not on whether the value is real, and rightly doesn't try to guess intent. Real environments supply these via Key Vault / managed identity (CLAUDE.md Section 4.7).

ArtGeneration._comment: Local development only — not a real key. docs/adr/0016. Deliberately not shaped like a real Gemini API key even as an obvious placeholder, same gitleaks-shape reasoning as the Stripe section above. TextModel/ImageModel are placeholders too, not a guessed real model ID (GeminiArtGenerationClient's own doc comment on why) — verify Google's current model list before setting a real value in any real environment.

Editor._comment: The editor SPA's dev-server origin (same placeholder OpenIddictSeeding.cs already uses for the OAuth redirect URI) — where Stripe Checkout/Portal send the user back to.

Play._comment: docs/adr/0010 — the play origin's own dev-server origin (Forge.Play, C4), genuinely distinct from Editor:BaseUrl above. GetBuildEndpoint uses this to build a Ready build's playUrl. Not a real Azure/CDN domain here, same local-dev-placeholder spirit as Editor:BaseUrl.
